cases.explain: «чистое золото» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: His head is like the purest gold. His hair is bushy, black as a raven.

cases.explain: «золотые жезлы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: His hands are like rings of gold set with beryl. His body is like ivory work overlaid with sapphires.

cases.explain: «мраморные столбы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: His legs are like pillars of marble set on sockets of fine gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
